SupplyCrate.purpose: Recovered village food and medicine; plank lid, diagonal braces and delivery seal.

TravelBindings.purpose: Untied convoy travel ropes with cut ends and a discarded wooden fastening peg.

LedgerDesk.purpose: Convoy manifests, northern orders and Eryn rescue maps; readable book, ink and compass.

ConvoyBadge.purpose: A captain badge on the convoy blue cloth; distinct from paperwork.

CartWreck.purpose: Ambushed relief convoy; detached fourth wheel, wooden spokes, broken tow shafts and recoverable cargo.

PrisonCage.purpose: Raider prison enclosure: bars on every side, hinged gate and padlock; captive NPC remains independent.

GateWinch.purpose: Return gate/lift mechanism; rope drum, ratchet teeth, safety pawl and hand crank.

CoolantValve.purpose: Dagna coolant circuits: bolted pipe flanges, brass handwheel and pressure gauge.

RouteLantern.purpose: Survivor route lantern: iron bracket, hood, glass enclosure and candle; no floating glowing sphere.

SignalMirror.purpose: Frozen Vale optical relay mirror; braced feet, pivot axle, adjustment wheels and a framed reflective surface.

SealWaystone.purpose: Safe-route signs and rune switches; a carved stone sign with an inlaid geometric route glyph.

PortalAnchor.purpose: King Shaman portal power socket; stepped altar, six stone blocks, brass collar and clamped crystal.

TrailEvidence.purpose: Convoy wheel ruts, boot heels and broken branches, grounded in the trail rather than luminous residue.

RuinedArch.purpose: Occupied cloister gateway built from staggered stone courses, voussoirs, capitals and a keystone.
